name: pixelated-canvas
title: Pixelated Canvas
blurb: Image rendered as pixelated dots that distort and swirl around cursor movement.
description: Renders an image as a canvas of dots/pixels with real-time distortion based on cursor position. Supports multiple distortion modes (repel, attract, swirl) and visual effects.
use_when: Interactive galleries or premium displays where pixel art aesthetic combined with cursor interaction creates engagement.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive devices — real-time canvas rendering with distortion is computationally demanding.
a11y: Canvas-based visual effect with no semantic content. Interactive distortion is purely visual.
